instance origin: the dungeon and raid list marks each instance new in WoW: Forever or from the original game; the nine new dungeons confirmed by Warcraft Tavern's Forever dungeon announcement, the instance map IDs (2959-3065) by the client's DungeonEncounter table

points.name: The Drowned City (outside portal)
points.note: Underwater cavern west of the Vile Reef, Stranglethorn Vale; swim down to Sunken Hollow (Forever dungeon guide and client tables agree on ~21.4, 27.9).

points.name: Zul'Alai
points.note: First boss, top of the hill right after the entrance trash. Level 37 elite undead troll.

points.name: Var'Taka
points.note: Naga with two Brinescale Priestess adds; near the Glowing Pearls and the stairs to Umbra. Level 38.

points.name: Captain Dreadrise
points.note: Patrols the north side of the central pool. Level 38.

points.name: Deathless Marrow
points.note: Spawns at the altar in the west and calls waves of undead guardians and sorcerers. Level 39.

points.name: Primeval Elemental
points.note: Underwater room in the southern area; kill the Undying Offering trolls to make him appear. Level 38.

points.name: Min'Loth the Serpent
points.note: Far west, final boss, two phases (troll, then serpent). Level 40.

points.name: Umbra
points.note: Rare murloc, not always present, by the stairs to Var'Taka with Saltscale Murloc adds. Level 38.

points.name: Gill
points.note: Rare goblin on the way to the Primeval Elemental.

points.name: "Pyromancer" Braxton
points.note: Rare human in the pirate section.

points.name: Glowing Pearls (barrier)
points.note: Interact near Var'Taka / Dreadrise to lower the barrier that blocks progress.

strategies.text: Monstrous Slam stuns anyone close to him, so melee can step out; Rotted Strike slows, so dispel the tank first. Below 30% he speeds up and heals: save cooldowns for the last third.
Kill the guardians first (they stun with Shield Slam) and cleave the adds off the boss; crowd control or fear when they pile up.
Two phases; he returns to full health in serpent form, which adds a fear and a poison volley that needs cleansing. Save defensive cooldowns for it.

notes: Positions inside the dungeon are not available from any source I could read (no map pins; Forever guides give no coordinates), so boss points carry x/y = null and only the ORDER is real. Order follows the Warcraft Tavern guide; one boost-service page lists a different boss set (Zin'aka instead of Var'Taka), so confirm in game. Level range from client tables (35-42). uiMapID unknown for this dungeon (instance map 2970). Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
